title: Continuity of Hermite coefficients in $L^2$
statement: Let $n\ge0$, let $(u_i)_{i\in\iota}$ and $f$ be real-valued functions on $\mathbb R^n$, and let $\ell$ be a filter on $\iota$. Suppose $f$ is square-integrable under standard Gaussian measure $\gamma_n$, the functions $u_i$ are square-integrable for all $i$ in some set belonging to $\ell$, and $\|u_i-f\|_{L^2(\gamma_n)}\to0$ along $\ell$. Then, for every multi-index $\alpha\in\mathbb N^n$, the Gaussian Hermite coefficient of $u_i$ at $\alpha$ tends along $\ell$ to the Gaussian Hermite coefficient of $f$ at $\alpha$.
hypotheses_covered: $\iota$ is an index type and $\ell$ is a filter on it
$u_i$ and $f$ are real-valued functions on $\mathbb R^n$
